articles.title: The New LEGO Shrek Minifigures Are Already on Sale at Amazon for Labor Day
articles.summary: LEGO dropped its first official Shrek sets back in June, but it wasn't until this month that the first set of Shrek minifigures were released. There are 12 new minifigures in total and you'll need to make multiple purchases to collect them all.
body: Thankfully, Amazon has already dropped the price on the six pack. Normally $30, you can now grab these packs for just under $25 during Labor Day.

Most of the characters will also come with some sort of accessory as well. For a better look at all that's included, you can check out the official LEGO page. Note that only Amazon includes the discount, however.

The minifigures are a follow up the first two official Shrek sets that released back in June 2026. There's the larger 18+ Shrek, Donkey, & Puss in Boots set (which features a Puss in Boots minifigure) as well as a set of BrickHeadz figures. The BrickHeadz sets aren't my favorite representation of these iconic Dreamworks characters, but the bigger build is quite wonderful.

IGN's Blythe Dujardin had the chance to put this set together and loved the overall experience and final product, saying: "What I do love about this set is that it feels like a real statue". You can see our full LEGO build review or flip through the slideshow below to check it out.

articles.title: Magic: The Gathering's Hobbit Gift Bundles Are Back In Stock at Amazon
articles.summary: In case you missed it, Magic: The Gathering has returned to Middle-Earth with some gusto. The Lord of the Rings set is widely regarded as one of the best Universes Beyond offerings yet, and The Hobbit is getting a pretty great reception from players, too.
body: As the set only launched recently, its Collector Boosters are harder to find than the Arkenstone in Smaug’s hoard of treasures, but Amazon has a “deal” that might get your attention.
We say “deal” because, as with many things with this set right now, the Magic: The Gathering Hobbit Gift bundle is being sold for more than its MSRP.
In fact, Wizards says it should be $89.99, so $164 is a colossal price hike. And yet, the same bundle can be found for $200 elsewhere, or is simply sold out with no sign of returning.

We’re giving you this information up front because you’re a big Hobbit now and you can spend your money as you please, but this is still a discount of 18% on the same bundle purchased elsewhere. If you really want it, buy it; if you don’t want to spend that kind of money, we get it, but at least you’re informed.

articles.title: Where to Play Every Grand Theft Auto Game in 2026
articles.summary: Rockstar Games seems to have an ambivalent attitude towards GTA's past, particularly the early 2D games and some spinoff titles, and its record in making these games available is decidedly spotty.
body: Grand Theft Auto might be the most popular game series in the world, and Grand Theft Auto 6 is expected to be the biggest entertainment launch of all time when it's released on Nov. 19. So you would expect the whole of the GTA series to be easy to find and play, right? Wrong!

The GTA series is often divided into three eras: the "2D universe," the "3D universe," and the "HD universe." As a broad rule of thumb, the games in the 3D and HD universes are mostly available, with some caveats, while the 2D universe games are unavailable unless you have old hardware or are prepared to get creative.
Now let's run down every game in the series and where you can play it.

The original 1997 game — played viewed from above, in 2D — predates Rockstar Games itself and is not officially available currently. For a while, it was available to download for free from Rockstar's website, but it was removed in 2013.

articles.title: Forza Horizon 6's PS5 Version Still on Track for 2026 Release, Playground Says
articles.summary: Forza Horizon 6 is still planned to launch on PS5 this year, despite not having a firm release date yet. Playground Games has confirmed it still plans to release Forza Horizon 6 on PS5 this year, following rumors that it might be delayed.
body: "If you’re planning your trip to Discover Japan on PlayStation 5, stay tuned!" Playground said in a post today. "Forza Horizon 6 will be releasing on PS5 later this year, and you can add the game to your Wishlist on the PlayStation Store to be notified of availability."

September and October are loaded with big releases like Marvel's Wolverine and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, but there is enough difference in the audiences for these respective titles for Forza Horizon 6 to still succeed. November, however, is a different story. Launching Forza Horizon 6 on PS5 in November seems like a death wish given GTA 6 is set to dominate the industry upon its release. GTA 6 is expected to have an in-depth car customization system and races in addition to all of the other features one expects from GTA, making it hard to imagine players choosing Forza over GTA.

articles.title: GTA 6 Will Launch Digitally at Midnight Around the World, So Of Course Fans Are Already Planning to Set Their Console Locations to New Zealand
articles.summary: Rockstar will launch Grand Theft Auto 6 at midnight local time in most countries on November 19 — meaning some fans are already planning to adjust their console region and play early.
body: Rather than offering a fixed time worldwide, the midnight local rollout means players in New Zealand will get a roughly 20-hour headstart on Mexico and elsewhere in Central America.

Of course, there are no GTA 6 discs to get started with early — even though Rockstar's long-awaited release will arrive as an entirely single-player experience. While pre-loading will be available, the game itself will not unlock until your timezone's allotted window.

Timestamps spotted on the PlayStation Store by GTAVice show 15 major release times for GTA 6 across the world's various timezones, beginning in New Zealand at 11am UTC on November 18, which is midnight on November 19 for our Kiwi friends.

After New Zealand, the game's rollout then continues through timezones in Australia, Japan, India, through mainland Europe to the U.K., then to the U.S. — though at least here, all the country will get to play at midnight Eastern. So, if you're on the west coast, you'll get a few extra hours to play before bedtime (if you actually plan on going to sleep).

articles.title: Cemetery Boys Sequel Reveals a Critical Role Connection New Reveal
articles.summary: New York Times bestselling author Aiden Thomas captured hearts and minds with the debut of Cemetery Boys in September 2020. It wasn't hard to see why: Cemetery Boys is a blissfully queer coming-of-age urban fantasy story that wrestles with identity, love, and finding your place in a community.
body: Moreover, its characters, Yadriel and Julian, were deliciously complicated. Yadriel, desperate to prove himself a real brujo and free the ghost of his murdered cousin, accidentally ends up summoning Julian instead. With Julian also determined to find out the cause of his death, the two boys have no choice but to team up — only to discover complicated feelings along the way.

Cemetery Boys: Espíritu picks up shortly after the original novel's ending. This time, readers follow Julian, who has a big problem: he can't stop seeing dark spots on people. Julian has no idea what these spots mean, and even Yadriel and his community are stumped. Answers start to come to light only when Angel, a nonbinary brujx who sees the same spots as Julian, shows up.

With Espíritu set to release today, Polygon got a sneak peek at one of the later chapters of the urban fantasy, narrated by Puerto Rican actor, drag king, and Critical Role newcomer, Vico Ortiz. articles.title: Persona 1 and 2 remakes are "something we'll probably eventually do," series producer says
articles.summary: With Persona 3 Reload out the door and Persona 4 Revival next in line, series producer Kazuhisa Wada has said remakes of the first two games will "probably" happen as well.
body: Developer Atlus seems to be on a mission to revisit every high-schooling, demon-mashing, double-life-simulating game it's ever made. In 2024, the studio pulled the gun on Persona 3 Reload before starting work on Persona 4 Revival, coming next February. But Atlus may reach even further back for some new (old) source material.

In an interview with RPS, Wada said the team originally came up with the idea to remake Persona 3 and Persona 4 around the same time. The latter "had to be put" on the backburner for a while, but the intent for both was the same. "I think a remaster or remake is some kind of cultural preservation," he said, per a translator.

Wada continued to explain that it's Atlus' "duty" to make sure its older games aren't lost to time "and are still around in the modern day." With that in mind, "Persona 1 and 2 are something we'll probably eventually do, too." There you have it, folks.

Persona 1 and Persona 2 are also the only mainline games in the series that aren't readily available to buy on any modern system, making Wada's point about "cultural preservation" even more salient here.
points: With Persona 3 Reload out the door and Persona 4 Revival next in line, series producer Kazuhisa Wada has said remakes of the first two games will "probably" happen as well.

articles.title: Lovecraft Horror Meets Snowpiercer in One of 2026’s Biggest Hidden Gems
articles.summary: I wake up, head pounding. A curt voice echoes through the room: "With immediate effect, free movement on the train is forbidden. We've been spotted again." I stand up and gather my bearings.
body: This isn't one of my recurring nightmares, though. I'm actually at Gamescom 2026 playing Dreadline Express, the debut game from solo developer David Konecny. One of the first things I say to him is that, as no doubt many others also did, it reminds me of Snowpiercer, which was one of the first pieces of fiction to popularize the concept of all of humanity inhabiting a singular train traversing Earth.

Much to my surprise, Konecny tells me that when he started development, he'd actually never heard of Snowpiercer, but he cannot deny the similarities the two have. But where the Bong Joon Ho-directed masterpiece (and Le Transperceneige by Jacques Lob, the original graphic novel before Snowpiercer ) was set during an ice age, the world in Dreadline Express appears to have been taken over by some Lovecraft-esque terrors.

Having played Saros earlier this year, one of the inspirations for that setting was The King in Yellow, a collection of H.P. Lovecraft short stories from 1895. In Saros, your crew slowly descends into madness, and when you eventually leave your room in Dreadline Express, you'll meet a few of the other passengers, who appear to be succumbing to the same thing.

articles.title: Final Fantasy Resonance modders have already reinstated the original mobile game's biggest icon, Ariana Grande
articles.summary: Final Fantasy Resonance doesn't launch in full until next month, but modders are already using its new demo to reinstate the series' most iconic diva. I'm talking about Ariana Grande, of course.
body: For those not in the know, Final Fantasy Resonance is an almost unrecognisable reconstruction of the now-shuttered mobile game Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. It's not exactly a port or a remake, but it's using the original game's story as a jumping off point.

And one of Final Fantasy Resonance's most unique ideas comes from Visions, characters from across the series' history who you can summon in battle. Cloud and Lightning and Cecil can all lend you a helping hand while in combat, but modders have now taken things a step further by adding every Brave Exvius fighter who didn't make it onto Resonance's roster.

The FFR Vision Studio mod brings almost 1,300 Brave Exvius units into the upcoming game's demo as Visions. That means every guest character from the defunct mobile game can theoretically show up, Kingdom Hearts ' Sora and Nier Automata's 2B included.
points: Final Fantasy Resonance doesn't launch in full until next month, but modders are already using its new demo to reinstate the series' most iconic diva.

The early 2000s hospital comedy about quirky doctors returned last year for its first season since 2010 (or 2009 if you correctly don’t count the ninth season). McGinley) appointing his former protégé J.D. articles.title: Two years after its rocky launch, Civilization 7's first paid expansion Earthrise is on its way - but first comes the atomic age
articles.summary: It's been a bumpy ride for Civilization 7, but two years after its widely criticised launch - and as the legendary 4X series celebrates its 35th anniversary - developer Firaxis has unveiled a host of new updates coming to the game.
body: Starting with the free Arc of Tomorrow update, it finally drags Civ 7's current end-game into more contemporary times. It introduces a new age, the Atomic Age, extending the current playable timeline from the 1950s into the near future, and adds period-specific gameplay, alongside new buildings, units, visuals, and more. As with other Ages, it'll be possible to begin a game straight from in the Atomic Age, or go the long way round, starting in Antiquity.

As to what the Atomic Age brings, there're new civilisations and leaders, as well as expanded nuclear gameplay options, including "a fun twist on mutually assured destruction." New Multilateral Agreements enable leaders to "collectively react to developing situations - like a growing stockpile of nuclear warheads - with calls for disarmament or escalation", and new empire management tools provide options such as the ability to transform Settlements into new City-States. Among other things, City-States enable Proxy Warfare focused on smaller-scale conflicts rather than all-out empire warfare.

articles.title: New Super Smash Bros and Nintendogs games are on the way, according to prominent Nintendo leaker
articles.summary: A prominent Nintendo leaker has spilled even more information about the console maker's potential plans, which include the long-awaited return of Nintendogs and an all-new Super Smash Bros. game ( not a buffed up version of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, apparently.)
body: The scoop comes from the ever-enigmatic Malo932, who first leaked that the company was preparing two back-to-back Nintendo Directs well before the Big N had the chance to tell us itself. They were also the first to claim that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, a new Star Fox and a Switch Sports game would come out this year, weeks before they were all properly revealed to the world.

News of another Super Smash Bros. game isn't super surprising - 2018's Super Smash Bros. Ultimate is the genre's best-selling game ever, and one of the original Switch console's defining hits. Series director Masahiro Sakurai has also been pretty quiet ever since wrapping up work on Kirby Air Riders last year.

In a now-deleted YouTube comment that was quickly shared by eagle-eyed fans (I managed to catch a peek at it over the weekend), the leaker also teased that another "cozy weird Nintendo series is coming back, barking. Wink wink, woof woof."

articles.title: GTA 6's Criminal Profile system sounds pretty interesting, includes a 'shattered' state for players who DGAF
articles.summary: The fidelity of Grand Theft Auto 6's world makes random violence look considerably less silly than it did when the characters had boxy claws for hands, but Rockstar isn't stopping players from doing what they want in Vice City and its environs.
body: We know that because we've seen the GTA 6 leaker shoot up a nudist party, murder the residents of a homeless encampment, and beat a delivery driver to death—quite a contrast with the mission-focused gameplay in the official reveal.

A little devil icon in one of the leaked videos did lead us to wonder if GTA 6 would judge us for antisocial behavior, a la Red Dead Redemption 2's Honor system, but the details that have come out since the reveal suggest that 'Criminal Profiles' aren't quite like that.

According to a preview from TGG on YouTube (embedded above), Rockstar doesn't want to punish players for how they play, or create a situation where they have to grind their reputation up to a 'better' level in order to progress.

This all aligns with IGN's learnings, but adds a few new specifics. What neither source came away with are specifics about how or how much Criminal Profiles will affect the story—will it lead to different endings, or just slightly change how NPCs interact with us?—but a comment from GTA 6 co-studio head Rob Nelson suggests that we will notice the effects of our actions.

articles.title: Capcom expresses continued interest in 're-activating IPs' as the first new Onimusha game in 20 years surpasses 1 million sales on launch day
articles.summary: Samurai adventure Onimusha: Way of the Sword notched over a million sales on its launch day, Capcom has announced. The success is deserved, per our reviewer Wes, who said that Way of the Sword "whips ass" in his 83/100 review.
body: According to Capcom, the one million launch day sales for Way of the Sword has put the Onimusha series as a whole at 10 million lifetime sales. The last new game in the main series was Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams, which released 20 years ago.

"In addition to regularly releasing major new titles each year, Capcom is focusing on re-activating IPs that haven't had a new title launch recently," the developer said. "The company is working to further maximize corporate value by leveraging its rich library of content, including this title."

It's become a cliche to say that Capcom's on a bit of a run lately, but here's yet another mile marker in the developer's 2020s streak, which has included a pair of well-liked Resident Evil remakes, two new Resident Evil games, Monster Hunter Rise and Wilds, Pragmata, Street Fighter 6, and Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess, among other games.

articles.title: New horror game The Well Is Not Empty combines photophobic monsters with timer light switches and a lot of frenzied digging
articles.summary: "Never show the monster," horror film-makers, game-makers and other creepozoids have chanted, over the decades. The Well Is Not Empty wastes no time showing us the monster - one of the monsters, at least - and doesn't seem especially the worse for it. I mean, it's the worse, but in a good way.
body: Look, you can see the monster right there, hunkered up like a frightened puppy in the corner of the room. A scrawny little fellow with broken xylophone teeth and eyes that genuinely do make me think of the view from the bottom of a well. The monster is no threat, as long as you stay out of grabbing distance - and as long as the lights are on. The problem, as you've already guessed, is that the lights are unreliable. A lot of the ceiling bulbs in the open areas are set to a timer. Best make sure you're back behind the sturdy radiance of those construction lamps before the ticking stops.

In The Well Is Not Empty, created by tweakEra with a demo on Steam as of writing, you're a villager sent to investigate why the water has run out. It turns out there's all kinds of shit down that well. Canteens. Offices. Expiring machines. Corpses clutching bloody letters. Some kind of huge prison complex, not entirely vacated. Balance beams over chasms. All of it brought to life in dingy, gangly, PSX-ified 3D.
points: "Never show the monster," horror film-makers, game-makers and other creepozoids have chanted, over the decades.

videos.title: Valheim - Official (Y)our Journey Developer Behind-The-Scenes
videos.summary: As Valheim’s 1.0 launch approaches, we look back at what was and towards the future at what will be. Thank you for embarking on this magical journey with us - a journey that’s yours, as much as ours.
body: Before journeying to the snowy biome, take a look back at the adventure. Join the team at Iron Gate for a behind-the-scenes look at the development of Valheim over the years in this new video for the open-world survival-crafting action-adventure game. The new video also features community members sharing their experiences playing. Finally, get a new look at the Deep North biome coming to version 1.0 of Valheim. Valheim is available now on Steam, Windows PC, Xbox, Humble, and Mac App stores. Version 1.0 of Valheim and the Deep North update will be available on Steam, Windows PC, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, Humble, Mac App stores, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2 on September 9, 2026.
points: As Valheim’s 1.0 launch approaches, we look back at what was and towards the future at what will be.
Thank you for embarking on this magical journey with us - a journey that’s yours, as much as ours.

videos.title: British Automotive - Series Trailer | Forza Horizon 6
videos.summary: A new series is coming to Forza Horizon 6: British Automotive!
body: This new update brings three new-to-Horizon rewards to unlock: 2025 Bentley Continental GT Speed, 2019 Ginetta G40 Junior, and 2006 Vauxhall Astra VXR.
Your tires are not safe from Drift Attack, the latest feature coming to Horizon Japan. Put your car sideways to earn points and climb the leaderboards!
Visit the Aftermarket Dealership and experience the British Automotive takeover with new deals on British vehicles and some Wheelspin-exclusive cars for sale.
